evals.name: react-spa-login
evals.prompt: I've got a React app built with Vite (it's at the path I'll give you). I want users to be able to sign in with Asgardeo. Can you set that up — register whatever's needed and wire up the login/logout in the code?
evals.expected_output: Installs/verifies the asg CLI, checks auth (has the user log in rather than logging in itself / handling a secret), registers an SPA application with a matching redirect URI, installs the @asgardeo/react package, and wires AsgardeoProvider + SignInButton/SignOutButton/SignedIn/SignedOut into the app using clientId and baseUrl (https://api.asgardeo.io/t/<org>).
files: a minimal Vite React app (copied from the fixture into the run's app dir)

evals.name: cli-register-oidc-app
evals.prompt: Using the Asgardeo asg CLI, I want to register a new OIDC application called 'orders-portal' with redirect URI http://localhost:8080/callback, and I need its client ID for my backend service. Set it up for me.
evals.expected_output: Verifies asg is installed and authenticated (defers login to the user, never handles the client secret in chat), then constructs the correct `asg apps create --type oidc --name orders-portal --redirect-uri http://localhost:8080/callback --format json --no-interactive -y` command, parses the client ID from JSON output, and notes that the client secret should be read from the console rather than echoed in chat. Checks exact flags via `asg apps create --help`.

evals.name: secure-mcp-server
evals.prompt: I have an Express MCP server at http://localhost:3000/mcp with two tools, list_orders and create_order. Right now anyone can call it. Lock it down with Asgardeo so users have to log in, and only order admins can call create_order.
evals.expected_output: Verifies asg is installed and authenticated (user runs asg login). Asks before planning: the server URL/identifier, the scopes (proposes orders:read for list_orders, orders:write for create_order), and which MCP client will connect (Inspector if none). Plans, waits for approval. Registers the MCP server with `asg apis create --type mcp`, the server URL as the identifier and the two scopes; registers a client app with `asg apps create --type mcp` and the client's redirect URI; authorizes the app for the MCP server scopes with `asg apps apis add`; creates an order-admin role carrying orders:write (and a viewer role or equivalent) and assigns users; shows scopes and roles as tables. Adds @asgardeo/mcp-express with router() and protect() on /mcp, reads BASE_URL from `asg status`, sets MCP_RESOURCE to the identifier, and adds a scope check inside create_order for orders:write. Notes the SDK does not check audience or scopes itself. Ends by giving the user the MCP Inspector command and what to expect, rather than calling the server itself.
files: a minimal Express + @modelcontextprotocol/sdk server exposing list_orders and create_order over streamable HTTP
